the aging brain has a decreased capacity to process new information, while it is more prone to process old information.

prior memories hinder new encoding in the hippocampus.

, in addition to the well-documented structural changes, the functional changes in the hippocampus during aging might also play a key role in the cognitive decline of the aged.
aging is not a simple loss of function but rather a reorganization of the neural circuitry.
the hippocampus is not a static organ, but a dynamic one that changes with the environment.
